high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a modern bathroom or vanity area. The individual is wearing a pink tie-dye two-piece outfit consisting of a crop top and a skirt with fringes at the bottom. They have long dark hair tied back and are holding a purple smartphone in their right hand, using it to take the photo. The setting includes multiple mirrors mounted on the wall, reflecting parts of the room. The countertop has a sleek, dark surface with two sinks and faucets. The background features a clean, well-lit space with recessed lighting and a minimalist design.
